hero_kpi_rationale: Ford reports a significant foreign exchange risk exposure of $3.0 billion as of December 31, 2025, reflecting the scale of its international operations and the complexity of managing its currency portfolio in a globalized automotive environment

kpis.name: Company Adjusted EBIT
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes, adjusted for non-recurring items, excluding Ford Credit
kpis.description: Measure of Ford's adjusted operational profitability, excluding financing activities and exceptional items

kpis.name: Foreign Currency Risk
kpis.explanation: Sensitivity of the market value of foreign exchange contracts to a 10% change in exchange rates
kpis.description: Foreign exchange risk exposure measured by the potential change in fair value of foreign exchange contracts following an immediate and adverse 10% change in underlying exchange rates
kpis.signal: Significant exposure to fluctuations in exchange rates amid volatile international currency markets

kpis.name: Commodity Price Risk
kpis.explanation: Sensitivity of the market value of commodity contracts to a 10% change in prices
kpis.description: Commodity price risk exposure measured by the potential change in fair value of futures contracts following an immediate and adverse 10% change in prices
kpis.signal: Stable exposure to commodity price risks (metals, energy, plastics, battery materials)

kpis.name: Company Cash
kpis.explanation: Cash held in Ford's investment portfolios excluding Ford Credit
kpis.description: Consolidated cash including cash equivalents and net marketable securities, invested under a strategy prioritizing capital preservation
kpis.signal: Stable cash position maintained to ensure liquidity across economic cycles

kpis.name: Foreign Currency Risk
kpis.explanation: Sensitivity of the market value of foreign exchange contracts to a 10% change in exchange rates
kpis.description: Foreign exchange risk exposure measured by the potential change in fair value of foreign exchange contracts following an immediate and adverse 10% change in underlying exchange rates
kpis.signal: Significant exposure to fluctuations in exchange rates amid volatile international currency markets

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.
